summary: Implemented the local P0-1 release contract by reusing the existing Worker snapshot builder to bind code SHA, publication generation/hashes, source policy, query generation and evidence catalog in a build-only release manifest. Worker and UI queries fail closed on mixed releases, while the production verifier checks Pages, all four Worker surfaces and an official evidence locator, separating local/build receipts from deployment-backed anonymous HTTP evidence. Updated workflow wiring and documented every acceptance group and all nine closure gates without claiming the meta issue is closed.
